mapper.update: UPDATE roomprice SET roomType = #{roomType}, roomP = #{roomPrice}, roomSp = #{roomSPrice}, roomUp = #{roomUPrice}, roomSfPrice = #{roomSfPrice} WHERE roomType = #{roomType}
mapper.select:
SELECT A.roomType AS "roomType", A.roomId AS "roomId", A.roomNm AS "roomNm", COALESCE(B.roomP, '') AS "roomPrice", COALESCE(B.roomSp, '') AS "roomSPrice", COALESCE(B.roomUp, '') AS "roomUPrice", COALESCE(B.roomSfPrice, '') AS "roomSfPrice" FROM room A LEFT JOIN roomprice B ON A.roomType = B.roomType
WHERE A.roomType = #{roomType}
SELECT periodNum, periodNm, periodStart, periodEnd FROM period

choose.otherwise: INSERT INTO period (periodNm, periodStart, periodEnd) VALUES (#{periodNm}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd})
